title: MultiWhiteList
description: Manage the whitelist of players on the server, with the unique command /mw addall adds all online players to the whitelist that are not in the whitelist
body:
**Manage the whitelist of players on the server, with the unique command /mw addall adds all online players to the whitelist that are not in the whitelist**

Features:

- Multilingual design
- Separate config system
- RGB support



<details>
<summary>Main commands</summary>
  
```
/mw add <nick> - add player
/mw remove <nick> - remove player
/mw list - view white list
/mw on - turn on system
/mw off - turn off system
/mw reload - reload configs

```

![menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5091b7b861bc3590e6cfec48a5ce9d3ba727abc1.png)

</details>
